subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> (S1) is Zhou Yu, the clean-shaven Chinese commander with black topknot crown and crimson bronze armor.
<Subject 2> (S2) is Zhuge Liang, the Chinese scholar with short mustache and goatee, dark scholar hat, ivory and blue-gray robes and broad white feather fan.
Both characters and the hall are defined by <Picture 1>.
summary:
[reference generation] One continuous cinematic 16:9 historical rap battle shot in the same ancient timber hall, warm red lanterns and cool blue moonlight shafts, hard overhead spotlight and light haze on the circular battle floor, audience kept outside the circle.
retention_analysis:
Preserve each visible character's original identity, costume, handedness, the black handheld microphones, the rigid white FEATHER fan and the same hall lighting and geography from <Picture 1>. Keep the camera framing, angle and lens character of <Picture 1> as the starting composition.
detailed_description:
Start in a WIDE shot from behind standing spectators whose raised hands and dark silhouettes frame the bright circular stage. The camera makes a fast, decisive forward dolly through the gap between their raised arms toward the stage, ending in a medium-wide shot: Zhou Yu at screen LEFT, Zhuge Liang at screen RIGHT. Zhou Yu pumps his free left fist upward on each beat while hyping the crowd into the microphone; the spectators raise their hands in response. Zhuge Liang stands still, lips closed, fan low, watching with a faint smile.
Zhou Yu alone raps exactly <d>[English] Yeah, yeah, yeah</d> following the rhythm, consonants, vowels and pauses of <Audio 1>. Start after the opening 0.25 seconds of silence. The other man keeps lips closed. Stop mouth articulation when the vocal ends; no invented syllables.
Main singer's face stays in a frontal or three-quarter view with unobstructed lips. Each microphone stays in the RIGHT hand just below the mouth, not across the lips. Zhuge Liang's LEFT hand holds the white feather fan, never in front of his mouth. Natural rapid rap articulation, head nods and shoulder drive on the beat, eyes locked on the opponent. Expressive but controlled arm gestures. Audience remains outside the battle circle. Keep both men distinct. No extra fingers, no changing props, no internal cuts, no written words or watermarks.
overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is the authoritative existing vocal performance and timing reference. Preserve it exactly; do not generate new lyrics, extra cheers, dialogue or repeated words.
non_diegetic_music:
No new generated music. The original Suno song is supplied separately for final mux.
